entries.title: Psalms 125:1
segments: ¶<A Song of the going up.> Those whose hope is in the Lord are like the mountain of Zion, which may not be moved, but keeps its place for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 125:2
segments: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the Lord is round about his people, from this time and for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 125:3
segments: For the rod of sinners will not be resting on the heritage of the upright; so that the upright may not put out their hands to evil.

entries.title: Psalms 125:4
segments: ¶Do good, O Lord, to those who are good, and to those who are upright in heart.

entries.title: Psalms 125:5
segments: But as for such as are turned out of the straight way, the Lord will take them away with the workers of evil. Let peace be on Israel.
